name: Bauernhof-Ferienwohung Neuschwendterhof
beschreibung: The Neuschwendterhof in Ebbs offers contemporary holiday apartments set on a lively, working farm. The units are comfortably appointed with modern amenities and benefit from their own private entrance. Animals such as cows, rabbits, and cats make the farm a wonderful adventure for young children. A spacious garden equipped with play structures and sunbathing lawns invites guests to unwind completely. The property is an ideal launching point for scenic alpine treks into the Kaisergebirge and around the Zahmer Kaiser. Ebbs itself provides excellent local shopping and dining, making the Neuschwendterhof the ultimate blend of rural charm and modern convenience.
